title: Hospital Engagement Co-ordinator
description:
Role description

We are excited to be seeking a talented and motivated individual to join Southampton Hospitals Charity as our Hospital Engagement Co-ordinator. This will be a dedicated Hospital engagement role and will provide the right candidate with a rare opportunity to build upon and develop our engagement with donors, visitors, patients and NHS staff in our Hub based in the heart of the hospital.

As a key member of our fundraising team, you will play a vital role in driving supporters and stakeholders to the hub to build a real sense of community spirit and a hive of fundraising activity

We are looking for an individual who is as passionate about making a difference and a people person, who is happy to work across the hospital meeting and engaging with staff and supporters. This role will form a key part of our ambitious strategy to grow our income, reach and impact. Working across teams, the engagement co-ordinator will help to promote and support our key marketing campaigns, fundraising initiatives, events as well as maximising the supporter journey and providing excellent donor care.

Main responsibilities

Charity hub
- Provide support in the Charity's hospital engagement hub, working within the hospital engagement team and covering the welcome desk, supporting with answering emails and telephone calls.
- To ensure that donation processing undertaken by the hub team and onsite administrative duties are carried out effectively and efficiently.
- To maintain accurate records of supporter interaction on our CRM system to aid delivery of an exceptional supporter experience and to harness the value of data.
- To work closely with the supporter care assistant to ensure all donors are thanked in an appropriate way.
- Support with the management of our tap to donate machines, identifying areas around the hospital where we can maximise donations and work with hospital teams to identify areas we can place more.
- Support the Marketing and Communications team to identify where collateral can be placed and make sure when items are out of date to remove these and engage with hospital staff to place new posters/flyers within the wards.
- Support our dedicated sessions within the main entrance of the hospital, that are the public face of the charity to raise awareness of our initiatives, generate income and support our engagement with staff
- To ensure all activity within team remit complies with the Charity's values, moral and ethical guidelines, the Fundraising Code of Practice and other relevant regulation and guidance.

Relationship building
- Build relationships with key stakeholders across the hospital to identify opportunities for fundraising and promotion of our grant schemes
- Collaborate with the community and events fundraising team to recruit and develop relationships with hospital staff taking part in events.
- To deliver excellent relationship management, ensuring a positive working relationship with hospital colleagues, as well as meaningful and supportive relationships with patient family fundraisers.

Cross working
- Assist and support other members of the fundraising team e.g., sending out events/fundraising packs if people visit the Hub.
- Collaborate across the charity with our Grants, Marketing and Communications, and fundraising teams to co-ordinate charitable activity and promotion within the hub and wider hospital.
- Support the arts team with the promotion of art workshops and other activities in the hospital.

Person Specification

Knowledge and experience
- Strong, demonstratable experience working with the public in a customer facing role.
- Strong communication skills and emotional intelligence. (you will need to be comfortable working with patients in a hospital environment).
- Understanding or experience of working or volunteering in a charity or health organisation.
- Experience of delivering excellent levels of customer care.
- Working to deadlines and prioritising work.

Skills
- Excellent written and oral communication skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to work independently, quickly and effectively under pressure.
- Good IT skills including Microsoft word, Excel.

Personal qualities
- Ability to build working relationships at all levels.
- Self-motivated, pro-active and solutions focused, with ability to work on own initiative and to provide recommendations.
- Personable with excellent manner and ability to engage stakeholders.
- Trustworthy, reliable and demonstrable discretion.
- Keen to be part of a busy, friendly team often under pressure.
- Flexible approach to working hours to meet the needs of the role.

title: Administrator
description: Important Information for Applicants : This vacancy is for Surrey and Borders Partnership NHS Foundation Trust (SaBP). This role is offered through Flexi-Bank, a collaborative temporary staffing service delivered in partnership between Surrey and Borders Partnership NHS Foundation Trust and Royal Surrey NHS Foundation Trust. Royal Surrey NHS Foundation Trust acts as the host provider and manages the recruitment, onboarding and administrative processes on behalf of Surrey and Borders. Please note that although Royal Surrey NHS Foundation Trust branding may appear on this advert and within the recruitment system, successful applicants for this vacancy will undertake bank shifts for Surrey and Borders Partnership NHS Foundation Trust. Work Location: Aldershot Centre for Health, Hospital Hill, Aldershot, Hampshire, GU11 1AY Why join Flexi -Bank? Work flexibly - choose shifts that suit your lifestyle and availability Access more opportunities - pick up shifts across mental health and community Get paid fairly and on time - competitive rates and fast access to earnings through Stream Stay supported - benefit from training, development and guidance from our dedicated Temporary Staffing Team Surrey and Borders is looking for someone To act as the admin lead for the team ensuring day to day supervision of band 2 and 3 administrators workload. Providing supervision and development to other members of the administration team in conjunction with Band 5 administrators, where appropriate. Working Pattern: Monday to Friday from 9AM to 5 PM To hold a leadership role with supporting the GPimhs/MHICS leadership team in representing administrators views To be a nominated champion user for the Interim Tactical Solution (ITS)/EMIS/SystmOne clinical record systems To conduct administrator system audits for the local PCNs and provide data as required. Provide cover for other colleagues in the admin team as required for short absences due to annual leave or sickness. Take and transcribe a wide range of meeting minutes in an accurate and timely manner Receive and process referrals to the relevant clinician and ITS/EMIS/SystmOne Update case notes on patient record ITS/EMIS/SystmOne as required Monitor annual leave requests and sickness absence for manager, as required Extract data from data warehouses i.e., DART Type up reports incorporating graphics and tables as required Type all letters dictated or provided by the team and nearby PCNs Book appointments on the patient record system for clinics and individual consultations Answer telephone calls and relay any messages in a timely manner Creating bespoke documents for the team, such as leaflets etc. Arrange team events, as required Monitor data quality of administrative input
